title: Distinguish authenticated ineligible native runs from incomplete acceptance scans
outcome: Native acceptance gives an actionable refusal for a coherent authenticated but ineligible run and applies the intended other-commit selection rule without treating ordinary ineligibility as malformed evidence.
acceptance: Behavior regressions distinguish genuine request/body/terminal incoherence from authenticated native ineligibility and changed after-run source.

A coherent ineligible native run at the current commit gets the intended ineligible refusal; a coherent run on another commit follows the documented skip rule, while genuinely incoherent newer evidence cannot expose an older PASS.
